title: 5.9 Ordering Politely 1: At a Café
unit_outcome: Name food and drinks, say what you like, want and need, talk about meals and prices, and order politely at a café and a market in Spanish.
goal: Order at a café: ¿Me da café, por favor? Aquí está su café.
grammar_function: ¿Me da + food, por favor? Aquí está/están su(s) + food. Aquí tiene.
speaking_outcome: Order at a café: ¿Me da café, por favor? Aquí está su café.
